description: This file defines functions and types for grouping and sharding test cases in the Playwright test runner, including logic for parallel execution, grouping by worker hash and require file, and filtering test groups for sharding.

methods.name: createTestGroups
methods.description: Groups test cases into test groups based on worker hash, require file, parallel mode, and hooks, considering expected parallelism.

methods.name: filterForShard
methods.description: Filters test groups to assign them to a specific shard based on total shards, current shard index, and optional weights.
